items.distractor_fact: Meteorologická stanice v sousední obci naměřila ve stejnou dobu teplotu {D} °C.
items.gloss_en: A weather station in a neighboring village measured a temperature of D°C at the same time.
items.entity_note: a different weather station, in a neighboring village

items.distractor_fact: Akcie jiné společnosti se ve stejný den obchodovala za {D} Kč.
items.gloss_en: A different company's share traded for D Kč on the same day.

items.distractor_fact: Hladina vody v jiné přehradě dosahovala téhož rána úrovně {D} m.
items.gloss_en: The water level in a different dam reached a level of D m that same morning.

items.distractor_fact: Sousední vrchol v tomtéž pohoří dosahuje výšky {D} m.
items.gloss_en: A neighboring peak in the same mountain range reaches a height of D m.
items.entity_note: a different, neighboring peak (not the hiker's own position)

items.distractor_fact: Na jiný účet u téže banky bylo ve stejný den vloženo {D} €.
items.gloss_en: D euros were deposited into a different account at the same bank on the same day.

items.distractor_fact: Jiná firma ve stejném odvětví měla za tentýž měsíc příjmy {D} €.
items.gloss_en: A different company in the same industry had revenue of D euros for that same month.

items.distractor_fact: Jiný tým v téže lize vstřelil za sezónu branky v počtu {D}.
items.gloss_en: A different team in the same league scored a count of D goals over the season.

items.distractor_fact: Jiný investor měl za tentýž rok zisky ve výši {D} €.
items.gloss_en: A different investor had gains of D euros for that same year.

items.distractor_fact: Jiná továrna ve stejném koncernu vyrobila ve stejném měsíci {D} ks jiného výrobku.
items.gloss_en: A different factory in the same conglomerate produced D units of a different product in that same month.
items.entity_note: a different factory, whose own production plan is not stated

items.distractor_fact: Jiný obchod téhož řetězce dosáhl ve stejném měsíci tržeb {D} €.
items.gloss_en: A different shop in the same chain achieved revenue of D euros in that same month.
items.entity_note: a different shop, whose own plan is not stated

items.distractor_fact: V sousedním regionu napršelo ve stejném měsíci celkem {D} mm.
items.gloss_en: In a neighboring region, a total of D mm of rain fell in that same month.
items.entity_note: a different region, whose own forecast is not stated

items.distractor_fact: Jiný vlak na jiné lince odjel ve skutečnosti v čase odpovídajícím {D} min od půlnoci.
items.gloss_en: A different train on a different line actually departed at a time corresponding to D minutes past midnight.
items.entity_note: a different train on a different line, whose own schedule is not stated

items.distractor_fact: Výtah v sousední budově zastavil v podlaží s označením {D}.
items.gloss_en: An elevator in a neighboring building stopped at the floor designated D.
items.entity_note: a different elevator, in a different building, whose own ground-floor reference is not stated
